name: Itchan Kala
description: Itchan Kala is the walled inner town of Khiva in western Uzbekistan, once the last stop for caravans before the desert crossing to Iran. Inside its roughly 10-metre brick walls, more than 50 monuments and 250 old houses crowd together, including madrasas, mausoleums and palaces. Don't miss the Juma Mosque, whose forest of 112 wooden columns fills its hall.
